readout_other: SLEAP deep-learning tracking of T2/T3 leg movements
direction_notes: Ultrasound evoked leg movement in flies that were still and suppressed movement in flies that were already moving; responses were variable across trials.
safety_notes: No comprehensive histology; light microscopy of the brain surface before and after exposure showed no visual change; output calculated to preclude thermal or cavitation effects.

exposures.label: 96 kHz miniature microtip source over the Drosophila central brain

target.label: the center of the right hemisphere of the central brain

device.model: modified dental ultrasonic descaler (Langevin stack) with 100 um ceramic wire-bonder microtip

timing.protocol_description: Tone bursts at 96 kHz, 1 kHz pulse repetition rate, duty cycle varied (30-80 %) with 50 % most consistent, delivered for 5 s inside a 15-s recording; 4-8 trials per fly with 8 min recovery. Bursts were always longer than 30 cycles because the source is resonant.

source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: Proof-of-concept experiments were conducted with the US exposure system, stimulating the fly brain at 96 kHz, 1-kHz pulse-repetition frequency (PRF), 50% duty cycle, with an estimated pressure level of 14 kPa.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_repetition_fre: Proof-of-concept experiments were conducted with the US exposure system, stimulating the fly brain at 96 kHz, 1-kHz pulse-repetition frequency (PRF), 50% duty cycle, with an estimated pressure level of 14 kPa.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.duty_cycle_pct: Proof-of-concept experiments were conducted with the US exposure system, stimulating the fly brain at 96 kHz, 1-kHz pulse-repetition frequency (PRF), 50% duty cycle, with an estimated pressure level of 14 kPa.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.sonication_duration_: Fly behavior was captured for a total period of 15 s with 5 s before and after a 5-s US stimulation.
source_quotes.exposures[0].free_field.pressure_kpa: Proof-of-concept experiments were conducted with the US exposure system, stimulating the fly brain at 96 kHz, 1-kHz pulse-repetition frequency (PRF), 50% duty cycle, with an estimated pressure level of 14 kPa.

flags.reason: 'Estimated pressure level of 14 kPa' with no statement of domain; calibration used an air-backed hydrophone at 100 um from the tip and a monopole calculation gave 20 kPa.
Duty cycle varied between 30-80 % (methods) or 20-80 % (discussion); 50 % is the proof-of-concept value recorded.
Only 'representative examples from six flies' and 4-8 trials per fly are given; total not stated.
Flies were cold-anaesthetised for preparation then head-fixed and behaving during sonication; recorded as awake.
